I need to work out each member of this chain: root plus णिच्, सन्, णिच्, सन्, णिच्, सन् in sequence, then शतृ. The root ध्राघृँ carries an anudatta accent marking it as ātmanepada by default, but once णिच् is added, causative rule 1.3.74 makes it ubhayapada (either pada), and then सन् attached to that brings in desiderative pada rules on top.

Following पूर्ववत्सनः, the desiderative of a causative formation inherits the ubhayapada status of its base, so शतृ remains valid throughout. For the first member, I'm working through ध्राघ् taking इट् augment with सन्, forming ध्राघयिष्, then applying reduplication rules — determining which single syllable (एकाच्) gets doubled, softening the consonant through चर्त्व, and converting अ to इ per the सन्यतः rule to build out the full abhyasa form.

Continuing this layered derivation, I apply णिच् to get दिध्राघयिषि, then add another सन् with इट् to reach दिध्राघयिषयिष्, reduplicating again since there's no explicit prohibition against doubling an already-reduplicated desiderative stem — landing on दिदिध्राघयिषयिषति as the fully derived form for this member.

For the second member स्फुड्, I apply णिच् with guna on the lighter penultimate vowel to get स्फोडयति, then layer सन् on top: the abhyasa consonant cluster reduces per शर्पूर्वाः खयः to फ, which becomes प under चर्च rules, giving the vowel shortening ओ→उ and producing पुस्फोडयिष — so the desiderative causative comes out as पुस्फोडयिषति, paralleling the known स्फुट् form पुस्फोटयिष्.

Now I'm pushing further to the causative-desiderative-desiderative (णिच्+सन् stacked twice): पुस्फोडयिषयति from णिच्, then adding सन् again requires reduplicating the first syllable, and I'm working through whether that first ekac for हलादिशेष purposes is just "पु" or includes the conjunct "स्फ्" — testing how शर्पूर्वाः खयः interacts with a cluster starting in प rather than श/ष/स.

Checking the jAgf example confirms both interpretations of hal-adi vs shar-purva khay give the same result, so for पुस्फ् the abhyasa resolves to पु either way after chartva. Continuing through the sanic and nic additions, I get पुपुस्फोडयिषयिष, then with nic प्रत्यय added again forming another reduplication layer, and I need to check ओः पुयण्ज्यपरे for whether the उ changes to इ given the following यण् and avarna.

For this abhyasa the प is followed by उ rather than अ, so पुयण्ज्यपरे doesn't apply and उ stays, giving पुपुपुस्फोडयिषयिषयिषति, then शतृ form पुपुपुस्फोडयिषयिषयिषत्.

Moving to द्रेक् (शब्दोत्साहयोः): applying णिच् gives द्रेकयति since the उपधा ए is guru and unaffected; for सन् the reduplication converts ए to its hrasva इ giving दि, so दिद्रेकयिषति, then repeating णिच्-सन् layers to get दिदिद्रेकयिषयिष and finally दिदिदिद्रेकयिषयिषयिषत् in शतृ form.

Now I'm working through व्री (वरणे, kryadi class): applying णिच् triggers वृद्धि of ई to ऐ, and I'm checking 7.3.36 to see whether पुक् augment applies here—since व्री isn't among the specific roots listed (ह्री, व्ली, री, क्नूयी, क्ष्मायी), it doesn't get पुक्, so व्री + णिच् becomes व्रायि through the ऐ to आय् conversion before इ.
